subject: Private expansion and isolation for MedSys renewal
messages:
From: Amy Li <amy.li@medsys.io>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.io
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private expansion and isolation for MedSys renewal

Hi Lauren,

We're gearing up for our account renewal in December and need to lock in capacity and topology decisions. Over the last year we've moved more sensitive workloads onto Redwood Private, and for the next term we want to:

- Add two new isolated clusters (one for PHI workloads, one for analytics-only)
- Keep the existing VPC footprint but create strict "islands" with network isolation and separate KMS keys
- Understand pricing for an expanded commitment vs. short-term burst capacity

Procurement has a 60-day lead time for POs, so we'd like to finalize the amendment and cost by mid-November. Can you send an options matrix (term lengths, committed throughput, and pricing) and any operational prerequisites (network, KMS, peering/IP allowlist)?

I've attached our current order for reference.

Thanks,
Amy Li
VP Engineering, MedSys Health
amy.li@medsys.io
Attachment: MedSys_Current_Order.pdf (PDF)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@medsys.io>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Private expansion and isolation for MedSys renewal

Hi Amy — thanks for the clear ask. High level options below; I'll attach a draft SOW and a topology sketch for the islands.

Option A — 12mo committed expansion (recommended)
- Add 2 private clusters (us-east) dedicated: 1x PHI-island (air-gapped option available), 1x analytics-island
- Commit: +25% baseline throughput; burst pool for seasonal spikes
- Discount: 8% on committed spend with a 12mo term

Option B — 6mo bridge + burst credits
- No long-term commit, access to burst pool (higher unit cost)
- Ideal if procurement can't commit before renewal

Operational prerequisites (summary):
- Network peering and static IP allowlist
- Dedicated KMS keys per island (we support customer-managed keys + HSM integration)
- SOC2 evidence and audit logs for PHI cluster
- On-prem provisioning lead time: 6–8 weeks for air-gapped appliances if chosen

Attachments: SOW_MedSys_v2.pdf, islands_topology_v1.png (topology sketch)

Next steps I propose:
1) Pick Option A or B by Nov 12 (procurement note taken)
2) Sign amendment (we'll prepare DocuSign link)
3) Kickoff for network & security onboarding in week of Nov 22 (if PO received)

Looping Aditya for technical constraints and Prio for commercial.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales (Private & Enterprise)
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-23T14:41:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Private expansion and isolation for MedSys renewal

Hi Amy — quick technical notes to help procurement and infra plan: 

- For true isolation we recommend separate clusters (not just namespaces). That gives independent KV caches, independent failure domains, and separate audit trails.
- Network: We'll need BGP peering or a dedicated VPN tunnel; static IP ranges must be provided for firewall rules. Expect a short maintenance window for initial peering handshake.
- KMS: Customer-managed keys are supported; for PHI workloads we recommend HSM-backed keys. We'll need key rotation windows defined up front.
- Monitoring: We'll provide per-cluster observability feeds; can forward logs to your Splunk/Datadog collector or use our retention tiering.
- Canary plan: We can bring one cluster up in a ‘canary’ mode for validation (read-only traffic) 2 weeks before full cutover.

I attached a concise network_requirements_v1.pdf that lists ports, CIDR ranges, and expected egress patterns.

Happy to run a 30-minute technical session with your infra team next week.

—Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: network_requirements_v1.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — that helps. Procurement confirmed the 60-day PO lead time (so Nov 20 signature target on our side to hit the Dec 31 renewal start). A few clarifications: 

- We want two isolated clusters in us-east as you recommended; PHI cluster must be HSM-backed and have a 90-day log retention for audit purposes.
- For air-gapped option: we likely only need it for a limited set of on-prem plug-ins; if available, we'll order one air-gapped node set and keep the other cluster in your VPC. Please include separate line items.
- Can you provide committed throughput in tps or tokens/sec for the proposed +25% so we can map to our SLAs?

Procurement also asked if there is any incremental onboarding fee for the canary cluster.

I'll confirm which option we pick by Nov 12, but please prepare an amendment and a DocuSign route we can send to legal.

Thanks,
Amy

Amy — thanks for the timeline. Commercial proposal to align with your procurement needs below: 

- Amendment: Add 2 clusters (PHI island + analytics island) + optional air-gapped appliance line
- Pricing: If you sign a 12-month committed expansion (Option A) we can offer: 10% discount on committed spend + waived one-time onboarding fee for the PHI cluster.
- Throughput: +25% baseline maps to ~18k tokens/sec sustained on the target instance types; burst pool adds elastic capacity up to ~40k tokens/sec for short periods (we'll provide a traffic profile to map to your internal SLAs).
- Canary: No extra onboarding fee for a read-only canary cluster; standard provisioning lead time applies.

I'll draft the amendment and upload to DocuSign. Expect a first-pass in 48 hours. If procurement can sign by Nov 20 we'll meet your Dec 31 start.

Action items:
- Redwood: send amendment (DocuSign) + technical runbook for on-prem appliance (Monica) — target Nov 4 deliverable.
- MedSys: confirm which cluster is air-gapped by Nov 12 and provide IP ranges & KMS contact.

—Prio (Priyom Das)
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: DocuSign_Amendment_LINK.pdf (placeholder link)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.
